monster.name: Charon, the Protector
senses: darkvision 60 ft. (can see invisible creatures out to the same range)

trait.name: Immovable Object
entries: At the start of each of Charon's turns, he gains a fire shield granting him temporary hit points equal to 10 times his current number of Unstoppable Force charges (see below), and his number of Unstoppable Force charges then decreases by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

trait.name: Unstoppable Force
entries: Charon has a number of charges (maximum 4, see Immovable Object above for how they are also spent) that increases by 1, to that maximum, each time he takes damage. In response to being hit by a melee attack, Charon makes an Unarmed Strike attack back at the enemy that made the attack. Each time Charon attacks back this way, he inflicts an extra effect based on his current number of charges:

items.name: 1 charge.
items.entry: The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. directly away from Charon.

items.name: 2 charges.
items.entry: The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

items.name: 3 charges.
items.entry: The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of Charon's next turn.

items.name: 4 charges.
items.entry: The target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is reduced to 0 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) fire damage. Regardless of the result, Charon's charges reset to 0, and the next attack that hits him before the start of his next turn is an automatic critical hit.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Charon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Charon attacks three times using his unarmed strike.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) bludgeoning, magic damage.

reaction.name: Aura of the Guardian
entries: When Haumea takes damage, if Charon is within 30 feet of Haumea or of the enemy that damaged her, he can use his reaction to teleport within 5 feet of Haumea or of the enemy (respectively) and take the attack instead of her.

legendary.name: Enhanced Rush
entries: Charon moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
